scope: Decisive transfer-DAG fit, fair completion/cost contract; no platform/source census, new performance model, build, board run or external-model call

verdict.reason: A finite complete layer-weight package is a useful preparation service object even without executing its consumer. Two iDMA requesters can test shared translation of explicitly projected fill/copy roles. Source requester identities, causal readiness, payload completion and legal direct/resident baselines must remain explicit. This does not measure GPU, NVMe or token performance.
verdict.not_required: Full commercial GPU, OPT6.7B inference or fabricated compute delay
verdict.not_allowed: Assign different DIDs to CUDA streams of the same GPU, call pre-filled DDR a physical SSD, or treat a second copy of the same bytes as extra useful work

reviewed_evidence.fact: MLP has six complete tensor weights, with shapes (4h,h),(4h),(h,4h),(h),(h),(h), copied into a read buffer for the first GPU batch. The two matrices and four vectors are all necessary to this package; retaining only large matrices changes the service object.
Author source includes OPT125m: input_dim=768, ffn_embed_dim=4*768 and default dtype=np.float16. Root's proposed h768 setting is supported, not a chosen compute speed.

Source preloads the first weight, prefetches next-stage weights, respects hidden/KV dependencies, and synchronizes the disk queue plus CUDA after each layer. Prior prefetch and synchronization are ordinary source behavior.

Disk labels route memmap-backed tensor work to four CPU relay workers; source copy submission and queue join are not independently proof of physical media DMA or CUDA completion. Global synchronization is separate. CPU/pinned direct paths exist.

Existing wrapper has two real dma_core_wrap instances with DID10/PID20 and DID11/PID21, real request mux and real cfg AXI accesses. Controlled-launch external hold/go/cancel inputs are tied off; private cfg submission remains the reachable boundary.

Single-copy helper writes source/destination/byte count and reads NEXT_ID; completion polls the matching reserved ID. Quiet requires TL in_flight zero, both DMA job_quiet and CPU quiet, followed by empty memory/AW/B queues.

Full-batch hardware issue/done accounting and byte/response conservation are reusable concepts. Its ready[j]=same-channel done[j-1], fixed two independent lanes and 262144B assertions cannot validate a cross-requester producer-consumer DAG unchanged.

Existing full-batch CLI freezes 64+64 transfers, warmup256, PTW latency31 and limited ring pages. The new finite package must have its own workload-derived counts, not inherit these numbers for convenience.

SYSTEM is a test approximation using real DS interface/delayer/crossbar, with behavioral DDR, reduced ports, no real CPU/cache/MIG/width/clock conversion and direct cfg bypass of production CPU fabric. Model cycle counts do not establish board costs.

Fixed R2 complete-work loss was 6006 cycles; ordinary first-block preparation left62, while the finite background completed earlier. Preparation/configuration/drain costs were billed and 2MiB expanded authorization to6MiB. This is a bounded result, not all AI schedules.

R2 does not exhaust legal compute throughput. All255 later tile handoffs had no extra supply bubble; startup delayed background first service13549 cycles, which mattered only if an independently sourced first-service target exists.

Useful task completion and full cost are outcomes; large pages/preparation/capacity/feedback/service are ordinary baselines; G0 does not modify production ABI; a covered branch can stop without rejecting the entire field.

minimal_task_contract.task: Prepare one complete OPT125m MLP six-tensor package in designated final destination addresses
minimal_task_contract.data_identity: Freeze exact ordered tensor manifest, shapes, dtype, offsets and source bytes/hash. Deterministic fixture values are permitted for transfer correctness but must be labeled as fixtures, not pretrained model weights or numerical inference.
minimal_task_contract.compute: Absent. Task ends at complete package materialization; no fake compute, artificial consumption delay, token throughput or later repeated-layer claim.

memory.rounding_guards_page_tables_metadata_ext: Must be itemized independently. Source, relay and destination use distinct backing regions; actual platform address/range acceptance belongs to the platform seat/root.
memory.reason_for_wholepackage_relay: Avoid imposing a tiny slot budget that manufactures starvation or repeated preparation; source four huge pinned workers are not replicated. Wholepackage relay is an explicitly different low-cost transfer projection, not source worker memory reproduction.

roles_and_identity.fill: One real iDMA requester projects storage/producer fill into host relay; physical storage commands, CPU memmap/pagefault/relay and SSD media are not implemented.
roles_and_identity.copy: One different real iDMA requester projects accelerator copy from ready relay to final destination; GPU CUDA/internal MMU/ATS/compute are not implemented.
roles_and_identity.DIDs: Keep each role bound to one actual wrapper DID. All projected GPU transfers share that one GPU-copy DID; do not use stream count to create requesters.
roles_and_identity.claim_scope: Two distinct hardware requesters sharing current RISC-V IOMMU, not a claim that current FPGA contains NVMe/GPU or that their protocols have been reproduced.

copy_compilation.required: Every tensor is fully covered exactly once at each required hop; final short chunks carry exact useful lengths. Never substitute 64+64 or pad byte counts into useful work.
copy_compilation.count_choice: Choose and freeze tensor-local or packed compilation. The two numbers differ because several vectors have short tails; do not mix their offset/ownership rules.
copy_compilation.exclude_from_useful_bytes: PTE/DDT reads, zero padding, relay copies, control traffic, duplicated preparation and retries

DAG.initial_ready: At common t0 the immutable package source is available and all ordinary policies receive the same manifest/roles/budget. Final destination is not pre-materialized.
DAG.fill_i_ready: Source fragment ready and its relay fragment write ownership free; do not infer readiness from when the scheduler chooses to issue.
DAG.copy_i_ready: Every fill chunk of the same source tensor has actually completed successfully before any copy chunk of that tensor is ready. The tensor barrier comes from the source tensor smart_copy unit; a same-chunk-only edge is insufficient. No planned issue, fixed delay or API enqueue substitutes for completion.
DAG.slot_reuse: A overlapping relay range can be written again only after its copy reader has completed. Wholepackage relay has disjoint ranges and no required reuse, so this does not justify serializing all chunks.
DAG.ordinary_overlap: Allow fill of another independent tensor on a different relay range to overlap copies of a fully filled tensor whenever legal outstanding budget permits. Preserve each whole-tensor fill barrier. A serial functional seed may test dependency correctness but cannot be treated as the strongest performance baseline.
DAG.package_ready: Every final destination fragment is complete exactly once, contents equal frozen source and all six tensors are present.
DAG.finish: Record package-ready and protocol-quiet separately; no STOP, dropped tails or truncation. Return boundary includes drain of both requesters, translations and all accepted DDR reads/writes/responses.

fair_ordinary_contract.fixed_budget: Same legal page permissions, hardware queues, byte work, source readiness, destination identity and declared memory budget for directly comparable policies. Permit normal full-buffer/inflight capacities; do not invent a one-child constraint.
fair_ordinary_contract.source_ordinary_behavior: Existing source prefetch, FIFO task publication and explicit synchronization must not be presented as new capability.

required_controls.name: legal two-hop FIFO pipeline
required_controls.purpose: Use all currently allowed independent relay ranges and hardware inflight resources. Compare with per-fragment serialized two-hop if causal interpretation needs it; full serialization is not assumed to be optimal.

required_controls.name: ordinary preparation and completion feedback
required_controls.purpose: Permit first-fill preparation with its time billed; already-ready downstream work can be selected before another upstream fill, and published fill work may be temporarily held using only current queue/completion/ownership feedback. Freeze the rule before measurement. No fabricated deadline or future completion oracle.

required_controls.name: resident/source-direct one-hop
required_controls.purpose: If source is legitimately resident and accessible to the accelerator-copy role, copy the same whole package directly to the same destination. Count its source residency, allocation, mapping and preparation costs. Current shared-DDR projection gives no inherent reason to forbid it. If it covers the target, the two-hop control hypothesis is closed for this seed.

required_controls.name: legal 2MiB mapping/preparation
required_controls.purpose: Include when aligned physical backing, authorization and isolation permit actual IOMMU large leaves. Keep the same package and compare matched mapping cases; charge reserve/allocate/map/clear/reheat and acknowledge expanded authorization. A CPU hugepage label alone is insufficient.

fair_ordinary_contract.feedback_control_point: Before cfg NEXT_ID publishes the next unsent copy. Once transaction VALID is committed or a transfer is issued, let it finish legally; no withdrawal/reset/quiet-mode switch erases the cost.
fair_ordinary_contract.same_information: Manifest, task identity, data/DAG readiness, legal buffer capacities and current completions are available to ordinary policies and any later candidate. Candidate-specific future timings or timing-free source preparation are prohibited.
fair_ordinary_contract.allocation_and_preparation_time: Model preloaded host-data/PTE setup may be a declared common boundary, but no measured benefit is claimed for deployment costs that it omits. Additional source-to-relay or source-to-destination preparation after t0 is always billed; if an already-prepared profile starts later, report and include the earlier work in total cost.
fair_ordinary_contract.quality_and_compression: Exact byte-identical package excludes lossy changes for this transfer service only. A later inference claim must allow ordinary placement/compression under the same independently defined quality goal; this fixed fixture is not an argument that such controls are illegal.
fair_ordinary_contract.full_cost: Report source/relay/destination/padding/guard reservations, PTE/DDT storage and permission span, metadata, queues/inflight, policy decisions/config/polling, preparation, drain and all useful completed bytes. Dynamic page/mode change additionally pays quiet, invalidation, configuration and reheating.

acceptance_and_interpretation.logical_function_only: Static DAG compiler and byte/hash/ownership checks establish that the proposed service object is well-defined. Its abstract done events do not prove real iDMA completion or IOMMU timing.
acceptance_and_interpretation.actual_DMA_function: Private adapter must drive real cfg AXI, track reserved IDs and actual hardware issue/done, maintain truthful cross-role ready timestamps, enforce all fragments/generations and source/destination byte equality, observe zero errors and eventual quiet.
acceptance_and_interpretation.conservation: For each requester: accepted AR payload=returned R payload, accepted AW count=completed B count, committed write strobes=sum exact written bytes; TL request/response ownership/counts and job-ID issue/done counts match. No request/response belongs to another tensor generation.
acceptance_and_interpretation.G0_registration_sufficient: Once actual-DMA function and fair ordinary alternatives are executable with frozen roles/manifest/cost/time boundary, register one bounded source-derived transfer-preparation G0. Registration is to decide whether a failure exists, not a declaration of failure, innovation or AI application reproduction.
acceptance_and_interpretation.translation_causality: Only attribute losses that actually lie on a required fragment/package completion path. PTW-active count or low hit ratio alone is insufficient; match mappings and data service, use existing queue/owner evidence or a bounded declared service intervention if needed. A priority intervention in behavioral DDR is a model explanation, not measured hardware treatment.
acceptance_and_interpretation.AI_G0_sufficient: For an AI application-loss claim additionally establish actual current-platform consumer/release and memory/workload constraints, or a captured source trace whose release times/physical DMA roles are independently known and replay fidelity shown. Full GPU hardware is not mandatory; fidelity of the claimed critical path is.
acceptance_and_interpretation.only_microbenchmark: Independent repeated DMA rings, assumed ready times, omitted tensors/tails, nonexistent mandatory storage traffic, or an artificial capacity/compute-delay bottleneck can produce a legal microbenchmark but cannot support an AI ordinary-failure claim. A complete source-derived role projection remains explicitly bounded even after its functional G0 passes.
acceptance_and_interpretation.no_compute_boundary: Real compute is unnecessary for package-ready task latency. It is necessary or must be independently sourced for token-generation latency, sustained compute-overlap, layer-consumption deadlines and reuse-lifetime claims. No device-speed scaling or picked compute delay substitutes for it.

one_conditional_direction.question: Does overlapping next-fragment fill with already-ready final-copy work create repeatable critical package-ready translation waiting that ordinary direct/resident preparation, large pages and current-completion feedback cannot cover at the declared cost?
one_conditional_direction.positive_condition: Necessary two-role work remains after legal residency/preparation alternatives, repeated useful final-copy fragments are delayed at the shared translation path, and the strongest frozen ordinary policies leave a cost-relevant full-package loss. Then select at most one bounded prepublication dependency-aware rule in G1 and compare it with concrete prior scheduling/preparation mechanisms.
one_conditional_direction.adjacent_counterexample: All package source is accessible/resident, so one-hop copies can legally prepare the same package without relay fills; or ordinary ready-copy-first feedback/large leaves remove the residual. Archive this seed's need for new shared-translation gating, not all AI-derived workflows.
one_conditional_direction.startup_limit: Stage100/101 only show that one startup strategy covered fixed slow-R2 foreground plus finite8MiB background. They neither prove recurrent AI prepare phases impossible nor authorize changing compute time/background lifetime until the new rule wins.
one_conditional_direction.novelty: Complete package preparation, DAG-ready labels, generic priority, credit feedback, initial prefetch and renamed AI roles are not independent novelty. Novelty requires a concrete additional capability and exact prior-work comparison after an actual residual is observed.

next_minimum_root_action.now: Freeze the source-supported h768 six-tensor manifest and one/two-hop DAG in a private artifact; make a logical compiler/checker prove coverage, per-fragment ownership, exact useful bytes and package-ready/quiet obligations. Accept this as static/functional projection only.
next_minimum_root_action.first_later_execution_batch: A private bounded cfg/DAG adapter for existing real two-iDMA SYSTEM harness, reusing issue/done and transaction conservation but replacing independent-ring readiness and fixed64/262144 assertions. Check function first; no production ABI change and no new compute RTL.
next_minimum_root_action.performance_only_after: Freeze legal FIFO pipeline, ordinary preparation/feedback, direct-resident baseline and mapping/cost policy; only then decide one bounded transfer-stage G0 comparison.
next_minimum_root_action.minimal_new_fact_for_deployment_claim: An actual finite AI consumer/service deployment on current FPGA, with source availability, memory residency restrictions, true requester roles and source/relay/consumer completion/release boundary. No additional GPU purchase or whole OPT6.7B port is intrinsically required.

model_to_board_cost_boundaries: Behavioral DDR omits MIG scheduling/banks/refresh, DDR controller buffers and clock/width crossings.
Direct cfg AXI bypasses CVA6 CPU/cache/software instructions, production cfg demux and board interrupt/coherence costs.
CPU relay/memmap/pagefault/pinning/cache maintenance, storage protocol/media/pagecache and CUDA submission/synchronization are absent from this projection.
New FPGA performance/resource claims need source/image/clock identity, actual permitted DMA buffer addressing and timing closure; current functional/static artifact proves none of those costs.

follow_up_actual_functional_acceptance.driver_execution_owner: Root built and ran two new complete serial RTL functional seeds; this seat only read and independently checked their completed outputs
follow_up_actual_functional_acceptance.bus_boundary: Independently reconstructed raw AR/AW/B header coverage/ownership/response counts; R/W/TL runtime counter totals checked against each job and requester, not independent per-beat replay
negative_variants_all_rejected: early same-tensor copy after its own chunk fill but before late tensor fill
